mechanism: Mefloquine may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing fluticasone systemic exposure and adverse effects, particularly when fluticasone is administered orally or via inhalation with high systemic bioavailability.
action: Monitor for increased corticosteroid side effects (HPA axis suppression, hyperglycemia); consider alternative antimalarial if fluticasone dose is high or switch to inhaled fluticasone with low systemic bioavailability formulations.
